rulings.title: Six app layers
rulings.text: O:I holds six app layers: Live holds M1′, M2′ and M3′ played as one instrument; Expressions is M4′ (the lived Expression, your own occasion); Technē is M5′; M0′ is the graph systems and the planet (O-I main f78bc6aa4, DLW manual §25.1).

rulings.title: One instrument per subsystem
rulings.text: Each subsystem is one instrument, "the device as a whole is encapsulated in the 0/5 layers"; "the 0/5 can be the full form with the 1-4 as a subrack" (Live's rack UI), recursively, as deep as the map goes.

rulings.title: Folding
